messages:
deploy-bot: Starting phased cutover for release v1.14.3 — 3-slice region-by-region rollout. Canary -> US slice 1/3 now. Pin: runtime=redwood-serving-2.1, model=rm-v1.14.3, quant=none.
deploy-bot: Preflight capacity snapshot: US (us-west-2) free GPU nodes: 11/12, est headroom 55qps; EU (eu-central) free GPU nodes: 6/9, est headroom 28qps; APAC (ap-northeast) free GPU nodes: 2/8, est headroom 9qps. APAC below preferred cushion.
maria: Ack. APAC warm pool is low, spinning up 4 reserved nodes now — ETA ~6m. Will monitor instance init. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
lee: Thanks. Quick ask: can we hold APAC if warm pool doesn't reach >=4 spare nodes? Recommend hold and route APAC traffic to EU fallback zone for first 4 hours. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR latency p95 > 800ms for 3 successive probes.
ajah (ops-sre-bot): @lee noted latency and 5xx thresholds set in release policy. Adding canary alerts to #eng-oncall.
ahmed: For APAC fallback, plan is to route to eu model variant rm-v1.14.3-q4_0 (quantized) if GPU shortage persists. That keeps latency acceptable and lowers GPU memory.
maria: Update: APAC nodes at 4/8 ready. Warmed caches from prefix store warming step. Moving APAC to slice holdpoint for manual go. :thumbsup:
jana: Oncall here — will watch errors. Please post canary traffic % increments.
deploy-bot: Canary US slice 1 -> 5% traffic. Observability hooks: cost/latency traces enabled, logging level=info.
lee: US canary smoke (5% -> 10% -> 25%) — watch p95 and 5xx. If error budget >0.2% while increasing, abort and pin previous version.
maria: US at 5% -> metrics: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.03%. No regressions so far. Proceeding to 25% over next 8m.
deploy-bot: US current traffic 25%. Canary passed basic smoke. Next: EU slice 1/3 canary starting now (10% traffic).
ops-sre-bot: EU capacity sanity check: node utilization 68% avg, KV cache hit rate 87%. No immediate hot shards.
lee: EU 10% -> metrics: p95=320ms (expected), 5xx=0.06%. Within tolerance. Continue.
ajah (ops-sre-bot): APAC still low on spare GPUs in the region despite spin-up, we have 3 ready extra vs target 4. Decision: hold APAC rollout slice until after maintenance window at 02:00 UTC, or failover to EU.
maria: I prefer failover for user-facing routes (edge-global) to avoid user impact. We'll update routing policy to prefer eu fallback for APAC region with span 4h then retry APAC.
lee: Agree. Update rollout policy: APAC traffic -> EU fallback until APAC warm pool >=4 nodes and healthy cache priming completed for 10m. If APAC health doesn't reach threshold in 4h, schedule staged deploy in next quiet window.
ahmed: Implementing runtime fallback config: `routes.apac.fallback = eu-central; routes.apac.model_fallback = rm-v1.14.3-q4_0; fallback_ttl=4h`. Pushing config now.
deploy-bot: Routing config applied. APAC service targets shifted to EU for Canary traffic.
jana: Observability: added dashboard card for fallback count and cross-region latency. I'll alert if cross-region p95 > 600ms for >10m.
maria: Release notes for internal: v1.14.3 includes kernel selection fix for long-context attention, batching improvements, and a small tokenizer tweak. No schema changes. Publish changelog to /docs/releases after full rollout.
lee: Rollback playbook (quick recap): 1) set traffic pin to previous version v1.14.2; 2) immediate stop of further slices; 3) notify SEV if 5xx spike >1% or data-corruption reports. Keep community channels ready.
ajah (ops-sre-bot): Canary US+EU complete for slices 1/3. APAC routed to EU fallback. No rollback required.
maria: Following up — scheduling final slice handoff tomorrow 02:30 UTC for APAC reattempt (after maintenance window). I'll post another heads-up.
deploy-bot: Rollout summary: US slice 1/3 ✅, EU slice 1/3 ✅, APAC slice held and routed to EU fallback ⏸️. Next scheduled APAC reattempt 2505099000 (timestamped task).
lee: Thanks all. Good coordination. Leaving runbook open for 4h monitoring.
jana: Oncall monitoring in place. Ping me if any spikes.
maria: Closing thread — will update with final confirmation after APAC reattempt. :white_check_mark:
